summary: The Order entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: The Order: 1886

emulation.notes: Use PS4 hardware or PS5 backward compatibility.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS4 release on PlayStation hardware

primary.why: The Order: 1886 is a PS4-only game with no PC/remaster route. The PS4 version is playable on PS5, so original PS4 media or PS5 backward compatibility is the archive path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PS4 version on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility. Record hardware, patch/version, display mode, capture setup, difficulty, chapter, collectibles, and whether any PS5 backward-compatibility differences were observed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster/PC route is sourced; document PS5 backward-compatibility behavior if used.
